String.string:
[EN] Assault the Assaulters
[ES] Asalta a los asaltantes
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Let's clear the western gate.
[ES] Limpiemos la puerta oeste.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Habere is safer now thanks to you.
[ES] Habere es más seguro ahora gracias a ti.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Centurion Turua at Habere's western entrance.
[ES] Habla con el centurión Turua en la entrada oeste de Habere.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Our enemies need a good sword-slashing!
[ES] ¡Nuestros enemigos necesitan un buen espadazo!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] It's been a while since I faced a worthy foe. I'll remember you.
[ES] Ha pasado un tiempo desde la última vez que me enfrenté a un rival digno. Te recordaré.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy the Thulsan chargers and their leader, Warkul, west of Habere.
[ES] Destruye a los coraceros thulsan y a su líder, Warkul, al oeste de Habere.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Centurion Turua at the western entrance of Habere.
[ES] Preséntate ante el centurión Turua en la entrada oeste de Habere.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
